text: Gardening is an enjoyable and rewarding hobby that can be practiced in various forms, from large-scale farms to small backyard plots. Mulch, a natural layer of material spread on the surface of the soil, plays a crucial role in gardening. It helps retain moisture, regulates soil temperature, and suppresses weeds, making gardening easier and more efficient. Compost, on the other hand, enriches the soil with essential nutrients, supporting the growth of healthy plants. By using both mulch and compost, gardeners can create a thriving and sustainable ecosystem in their garden.
